details.note: The ticket's premise was wrong and the error was mine. 4,352 was the page's twelve month all-countries impressions; 11 was the cluster's named-query count over three months, UK only, at 9 percent coverage. Different measures. The page actually earned 289 impressions over three months across both its URLs, has 17 inbound links, and is technically sound. The real observation is hundreds of impressions and no clicks at position 25 to 35, which is position, not snippet.

details.outcome: answered: intent mismatch, not a snippet problem
details.source: Google Search, manual human observation, screenshots supplied by Peter
details.locale: United Kingdom, TW19 6BB Stanwell Moor, personalised results
details.features_seen: No AI overview. No featured snippet. No People Also Ask. One Images block mid-page. A People also search for block at the foot.
details.note: The query is substantially navigational for Punch Pubs. Punch Pubs Support, A Guide To Your Punch Services (PDF), Punch Taverns Buying Club, Punch Taverns and the Punch Pubs Publicans Forum (twice) all rank, and People also search for is led by Punch Pubs, Punch pubs contact number and Punch pubs login. A second intent is physical maintenance: Vidette UK commercial refurbishment and Masterfix Pub Maintenance London. Only a minority of the page is business turnaround, where the one direct competitor is simonmckenzie.co.uk, Pub Turnaround Specialist UK, promising to stop the bleeding within 90 days. Orange Jelly appeared around position 3 in this personalised view, but with the wrong page: Pub VAT and Accounting, not the cluster target. Results were personalised and searched from the owner's own postcode, so treat the position as indicative only; Search Console reports the query at average position 4.95 with 59 impressions and no clicks over three months.
